text_block_list.name: Cat-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah... Why aren't pets allowed in the 
dorms...? I wanna see him every day~~ I 
wanna fluff him up~~... My kitty... Uuu.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That must be... so painful for you. Being 
separated from your precious family, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! ...*sniff*, Pisa, you're 
the only one who'd ever listen to silly 
worries like this.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's a story about a precious 
cat, so I'd be happy to talk about it as 
much as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pisaaa~!! You really are an angel... Wait, 
lookin' closely, you've got the exact same 
coat as my little angel! L-Let me fluff 
you up~~!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If my tail brings you comfort, go right 
ahead. Come on, don't be shy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having stayed up late into the 
night giving her friend headpats, Victoire 
Pisa ended up going to bed very late.
